title: Craftable Chainmail Armor
body:
### This small mod add Craftable chain mail Armor
To fully craft the armor, 6 iron ingots are required.
| Item             | A picture of crafting from the game             |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|
| Chain mail Rings            | ![Craft ingredient](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/faa9525eef7c4212e40333943cb552f1d054b1da.png)              |
| Chain mail Helmet            | ![Craft Chainmail Helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d6a285f35dac28156b07314d6665a694ab56b1e.png)             |
| Chain mail Chestplate            | ![Craft Chainmail Chestplate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/517c63f13aa24ddd2a8620dd17f051288899b660.png)              |
| Chain mail Leggins |![Craft Chainmail Leggins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75f3f6dee073e6d870f14362cb079aa4824993f0.png) |
| Chain mail Boots   | ![Craft Chainmail Boots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09d6626800973faaf226b8cd01170c38c71c6e41.png) |
